name: PHAR 5303
title: Small Molecule Structure and Function
description: Small organic molecules continue to be the preeminent form of therapeutic agents.  The small molecules that constitute clinically used agents are developed through a highly interdisciplinary process involving chemists, biologists and healthcare workers in a process commonly referred to as drug discovery. The purpose of this course is to provide the student with a broad view of drug properties, drug function and the drug discovery process.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
